description: Returns the reviewed area details of a launch by slug: address, tenure, nearby amenities with straight-line distances, schools within two kilometres, and food places the agent has visited himself. Where the area has been measured, it also returns the three nearest MRT or LRT stations with straight-line and walking distances, stop counts to six key stations, and primary school bands per block, each labelled with its source and date. Schools are listed for orientation only and the reply says where to verify them. Available for launches that show area details in list_launches, even when floor plans are not yet available. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

slug.description: The launch slug, as returned by list_launches
